notes: Inventory from V3 source. Final Play answers must be reconciled with the built AAB and every shipped SDK.

data.retention: Current-query use; no location-history product feature

data.notes: Includes profile/public facility images and private owner verification evidence. Evidence is not public.

The backend declares eighteen interaction events and an ingest endpoint (analytics/registry.py, POST /api/v1/analytics/events/), and its registry explicitly rejects precise coordinates, tokens, full phone numbers and evidence IDs. The Android app does not send them yet: core:analytics holds an AnalyticsTracker interface whose only implementation is NoOpAnalyticsTracker, and nothing binds or calls it, so an AAB built from this source collects no app interaction from the phone. Events the backend records from requests it serves anyway are its own. Mark collected once a tracker posts to that endpoint, and reconcile the event list with the registry as shipped.
Push tokens are encrypted at rest with a digest for lookup.

Sentry (io.sentry:sentry-android-core) ships in the AAB but initialises only when the build carries DIRECTORY_SENTRY_DSN; without it nothing is collected. With it: crash stacks, device model and OS version, release and flavour; no user, request, screenshot, view hierarchy, session tracking or breadcrumb data (CrashReporting.kt). Mark collected only for a release built with a DSN.
